svg.title: EP2 C3 AREA 16
svg.desc: In CCA, fight gatekeepers only. Complete every marked fixed pickup and split-route mechanism. Short area: only the Mericarol must be defeated to move on. The FO walks forward into the open room and clears the Mericarol, then everyone continues to the next area. Watch out when the Mericarol starts ticking; the warp to the next area appears only after it falls.
